label: Drizzle ORM + drizzle-kit (PostgreSQL)
description: Hand-written TypeScript schema as the source of truth; drizzle-kit derives SQL migrations from it. Soft delete is an explicit isDeleted column.

vars.name: Drizzle ORM
quality_checks: Reads always exclude soft-deleted rows with `eq(table.isDeleted, false)`
Composable `SQL` condition-builders (query objects) are used for complex filtering
Drizzle `select`/relational `with` fetch only needed columns — no N+1 (batch/relation-load instead of per-row queries)
claude_rules: Every read excludes soft-deleted rows — compose `eq(table.isDeleted, false)` into the `where`
Never hand-edit files under `apps/api/drizzle/` — change the schema and run `npx drizzle-kit generate`

protect-migrations.message: Drizzle migrations are generated, not written. Change the schema in <% orm.schema_dir %> and run 'npx drizzle-kit generate' from apps/api instead.

protect-generated-files.message: This is a generated drizzle-kit snapshot. Change the schema in <% orm.schema_dir %> and regenerate — hand-editing it corrupts migration history.

context: The Drizzle schema at `apps/api/src/db/schema/` is the source of truth for the database
Migrations under `apps/api/drizzle/` are generated by drizzle-kit and are never hand-edited
rules: Every schema change requires a generated migration (`npx drizzle-kit generate --name <name>`)
Every read filters out soft-deleted rows with `eq(table.isDeleted, false)`
